normalization: strip whitespace; RDKit MolFromSmiles sanitize=True; canonical isomeric SMILES; reparse; retain fragments, charge, stereochemistry; no neutralization, desalting or tautomer canonicalization
valid_definition: nonempty non-INVALID SMILES parsed/sanitized by RDKit and canonical roundtrip succeeds
duplicates: retained as independent generation records, never deduplicated in primary property means
reference: per-target TG valid-molecule QED median; strictly > / <; ties reported separately
effect_sizes: Cliffs delta and Hedges g from independent valid-molecule distributions; no paired tests or row matching
